name: Mexico

flag.description: Three equal vertical bands of green, white and red, with the coat of arms in the center: a golden eagle perched on a prickly pear cactus devouring a snake.
flag.symbolism: Green is commonly said to represent hope, white unity and red the blood of national heroes; the eagle recalls the Aztec legend of the founding of Tenochtitlan.

hook: Mexico is Italy plus an eagle eating a snake on a cactus, on a longer 4:7 rectangle; Ireland swaps the red for orange.
trivia: According to legend, the Aztecs founded Tenochtitlan, now Mexico City, where they saw an eagle on a cactus eating a snake.
Mexico celebrates Flag Day on 24 February.
